classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Compact binder backbone design: generate 2 RFdiffusion binder candidates against a user-supplied target protein structure, characterise the target sequence biochemically, and rank the 2 backbone candidates.
assumptions: target_pdb is a local file path to the target protein PDB; the workflow cannot execute without it
target_sequence is the FASTA sequence string for the target chain; used for biochemical context only and does not block rfdiffusion execution
Binder length defaults to 70–100 residues as a compact, low-risk starting window; adjustable via workflow params
No hotspot residues provided; RFdiffusion will diffuse binders unconditionally over the full target chain (chain A assumed)

boltz2_affinity is excluded from the node graph: RFdiffusion produces backbone PDB files without chain sequences; a sequence design step such as ProteinMPNN or LigandMPNN is a prerequisite for affinity scoring and is absent from the current tool set
rank_designs scores candidates from rfdiffusion top_candidates using diffusion-internal metrics; affinity-based re-ranking is a recommended follow-up after downstream sequence design

sequence_analysis of the target provides biochemical liability context for the scientist but is not wired into rank_designs because the output fields are target-level, not binder-candidate-level, objects
missing_inputs: target_pdb: local path to target protein PDB file — required to run rfdiffusion in binder_backbone_design mode
target_sequence: FASTA sequence string for the target chain — required for sequence_analysis node
binder sequence: rfdiffusion does not emit chain sequences; boltz2_affinity requires a ProteinMPNN or LigandMPNN sequence design step not present in the current tool set
